title: ArXiv will ban researchers who upload papers full of AI slop
brief: ArXiv will ban researchers for one year if they upload papers with incontrovertible evidence of unchecked AI-generated content, including hallucinated references and LLM meta-comments. The policy, announced by ArXiv's computer science section chair Thomas Dietterich, aims to reduce "AI slop" on the platform and requires future submissions to be accepted at peer-reviewed venues.
